steps.title: Four everyday verbs
body: This short lesson introduces four common A1 verbs you will use to talk about communication and perception: to speak, to hear or listen, to see, and to understand.
Each is given in its past-tense (he-) form, which is the dictionary form of an Arabic verb. The present-tense form is noted where the object carries one.

steps.title: The verbs
steps.intro: Tap each card to hear it. The transliteration and meaning come straight from the vocabulary entries — nothing here is added by hand.

steps.title: Done
steps.message: You met four A1 verbs: to speak, to hear/listen, to see, and to understand. Practise them in the Review view to keep them.
